exampleTarget: برف را از بام پاک کردیم.
exampleTranslit: barf rā az bām pāk kardēm.
exampleEn: We cleared the snow off the roof.

exampleTarget: راننده ما را تا دروازه پوهنتون رساند.
exampleTranslit: rānanda mā rā tā darwāza-ye pōhantūn rasānd.
exampleEn: The driver took us as far as the university gate.

glossEn: boiling, the boil (جوش دادن to boil, جوش آمدن to come to the boil)
exampleTarget: آب برای چای به جوش آمد.
exampleTranslit: āb barā-ye chāy ba jōsh āmad.
exampleEn: The water for the tea has come to the boil.
